release_notes:
SMS overhaul (Twilio 7.x + Textbelt), SMS Logs, responsive admin login, social link previews

- Provider-based SMS gateways: Twilio SDK updated 6.40 to 7.16 and Textbelt added as a new provider; the gateway form adapts its fields to the selected provider. Removed the retired Infobip integration.
- Per-workflow SMS toggles: enable order notifications individually (Successful/Cancelled IMEI, File and Server orders) from Settings > SMS. Replaces the old single Send SMS switch.
- Order and OTP SMS now validate the recipient phone number (E.164) before sending, and support a new #DOMAINNAME# template placeholder.
- New SMS Logs page (under SMS Gateways): every message sent is logged with order no, customer, message id and an on-demand delivery-status check; includes a purge option.
- The admin login page is now responsive on mobile.
- Fixed admin login console errors: missing jQuery Validation script, rotating background images and a favicon 404.
- Added Open Graph / Twitter meta tags so shared links (WhatsApp, Facebook) show a proper title, description and site icon.
